Jennings Lecturer of Business Administration Lecturer of Business Administration Tom Jennings is a Lecturer in the Entrepreneurial Management unit at Harvard Business School. He teaches The Entrepreneurial Manager (TEM), a required class for all first-year students, and has served as an Executive Fellow for Venture Capital and Private Equity (VCPE), an elective course. Tom is also a Senior Advisor at Summit Partners, a growth equity firm with $45 billion under management, where he has worked since 1997 and was most recently a Managing Director and member of the firm’s Board of Managers.
